packageRules.description: Workflow input fields (e.g. golangci-lint-action `version:`, setup-go `go-version:`) cannot carry a digest comment, so pinDigests fails the branch.
slsa-github-generator reusable workflows must stay tag-pinned; their builder script rejects SHA refs.
Renovate skips `// indirect` Go requirements by default.
Indirect deps are not part of this module's own API and CI gates them, so let minor and patch land unattended.

A Go major bump changes the module path, so on an indirect dep it appends a second copy (e.g. backoff/v7) alongside the original rather than replacing it. The old path stays until the direct dep that imports it moves, so Renovate re-proposes the same update every run. Let these arrive via their parent instead.
